name: cleanup
description: Audit and clean the whole brain. Checks the projects (finished, forgotten, misplaced), the memories (duplicates, facts that are no longer true, heavy files, dead links in AGENTS.md, About.md, Roadmap.md and notes), the skills (unused, duplicated, broken) and the loose files, shows one list of what to archive, merge, fix or trash, and does only what the user approves. Use when the user types /cleanup, says "fais le ménage", "range mon brain", "audite le cerveau", "audite les mémoires", "audite les skills", "archive les vieux projets" or the brain feels messy.
